rules: Use tight letter spacing for large text.
Stage colors MUST be strictly preserved.
Use tinted greys (stone) to provide organic warmth.
Do NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.

grids.stage_cards: col-span-full grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4

layouts.container: Strict grid hierarchy, dense and compact spacing.
layouts.responsive: Mobile-first: Desktop table, Mobile card layout.
layouts.spacing_scale: p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8. Use generous padding inside containers.

StageCards.description: Clickable to filter. Unselected state uses subtle borders. Selected state gets a 2px solid border of the respective stage color and a subtle tinted background. Adds -translate-y-1 on hover.

CustomerTable.description: Cardless or subtle roundness (max 8px border-radius) with dense styles. Left-align text, right-align numbers.

BulkReengageBanner.description: Appears above the table when a stage is selected. Background is a 10% opacity tint of the stage color, with a solid 1px border. Includes a bold CTA button.

ReengageModal.description: Inline Sheet or Dialog. Must show realistic WhatsApp bubble preview with #25D366 submit button.

motion.interactions: Hover states on table rows (bg-muted/50), subtle lift (-translate-y-1) on stage cards.
motion.transitions: transition-transform duration-200 ease-out, transition-colors duration-200 ease-out.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px subtle borders (border-border/40). Apply Grid Borders look for the table to expose the technical skeleton.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Very subtle ambient shadows (shadow-sm) on cards, crisp inner glow on buttons.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Neumorphism (Tactile) variant for dashboard widgets: flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default, subtle shadow on hover.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over brand/stage colors meets APCA contrast guidelines. Text on WhatsApp Green should be dark or use text-shadow if white.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have higher contrast than default state.

media.images: Not heavily required for CRM. Use Lucide React icons.

3d_libraries.steps: Use Recharts for the Area Chart (Lifecycle trend) and a custom stacked div for the Stage distribution bar.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard prioritizing the table's density and clarity.
Implement a responsive layout: table on desktop, stack of cards on mobile.
Strictly apply the specified stage colors for badges, distribution bar, and the trend chart.
The Re-engage Modal should accurately replicate a WhatsApp chat bubble using the tailwind styling (rounded corners with one sharp corner, greenish background for outgoing message).
Ensure 'Re-engage Churned Customers' bulk CTA is prominent when clicking a stage card.
Ensure the UI components are functional (e.g., clicking a stage card filters the table, and shows the banner).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Do not apply universal transitions like 'transition: all'.
Do not center align the app container via CSS (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use modern pill-shaped or slightly rounded buttons with interaction animations.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use Lucide React icons.
Add hover states, active states, and focus-visible rings to all interactive elements.
Use sonner for toasts. Component located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
